description: This file defines a custom exception class 'ThingTooManyModifyingRequestsException' used in the Eclipse Ditto project. It represents an error condition where too many modification requests have been made to a single 'Thing' in a short period. The class includes static factory methods, a builder class, and references to external classes like DittoHeaders, ThingId, and JSON handling classes.

classes.name: ThingTooManyModifyingRequestsException
classes.description: A final immutable exception class indicating that too many modification requests have been made to a specific 'Thing'. Includes static factory methods and a nested builder class.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A thread-unsafe builder class for constructing 'ThingTooManyModifyingRequestsException' instances with a fluent API.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for the exception, initialized with the given ThingId.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a custom message and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an exception instance from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers.
